_instructions: TEMPLATE for AI agents: fill in this JSON to build a quiz for quiz-maker.html.

1. meta.language: which language(s) to use for the INTERFACE (chrome, title/subtitle/intro/author/after-test, explanations) — "en", "ku", "both", or "auto" (default). "auto" keeps both languages when the input carries them, otherwise the single language present.

2. meta.content_language: which language the TEST ITSELF uses (question, answers, category) — "ku" or "en" pins it, or leave it out (or empty) to follow the interface switch. Use e.g. language "both" with content_language "ku" to keep questions in Kurdish while the interface can flip to English.
3. meta.title / meta.title_en: quiz name shown at the top. meta.subtitle / meta.subtitle_en: optional one line under it.
4. meta.after_test / meta.after_test_en: optional message shown on the results screen after the quiz is finished. Newlines are preserved.
5. meta.author / meta.author_en: optional quiz author. Leave it out or empty for no line; otherwise it shows as "Quiz Author - <name>" (Kurdish: "نووسەری تاقیکردنەوە - <ناو>").
6. meta.intro / meta.intro_en: optional list of extra bullet lines for the start screen (category counts are added automatically). If omitted, two default bullets are used.
7. questions: array. Each item has category/category_en, question/question_en, options/options_en, correct (0-based index), explanation/explanation_en.
8. options and options_en must be the same length and same order; 'correct' points into that order.

9. Base keys are Kurdish; the '_en' keys are English. You may fill only one language; the other falls back automatically. With meta.language "both" (or "auto" when both languages are present) the quiz shows a Kurdish/English switch.
10. Direction is auto-detected from the text itself, per field: Kurdish/Arabic text renders RTL and English/Latin text LTR, so no direction flag is needed.
11. Remove this '_instructions' key when you are done (optional but cleaner).
